messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 47(6)

Article 47 Exercise of the delegation. 6. A delegated act adopted pursuant to Articles 6(2), 6(11) or 7(2) shall enter into force only if no objection has been expressed either by the European Parliament or by the Council within a period of two months of notification of that act to the European Parliament and the Council or if, before the expiry of that period, the European Parliament and the Council have both informed the Commission that they will not object. That period shall be extended by two months at the initiative of the European Parliament or of the Council.

Objection period | hasLength | two months | runs from notification of the act to the European Parliament and the Council | "within a period of two months of notification of that act to the European Parliament and the Council"
European Parliament and Council both informing the Commission | allowsEarlyEntryIntoForce | delegated act | both inform the Commission before the period expires that they will not object | "if, before the expiry of that period, the European Parliament and the Council have both informed the Commission that they will not object"
